set.pl: Eaton crossroads, about a block north of State Highway 29 at County T, Town of Eaton (Brown), about 12 mi E of Green Bay
set.t: The house stood about a block north of Highway 29 at Eaton (Green Bay Press-Gazette). Look for the old house site north of the highway near County T on the 1938 aerial. Access: private: permission.
pinev: Green Bay Press-Gazette 12 Oct 1932: house "at Eaton, about a block north of Highway 29"; pin a block north of today's STH 29 at County T (parcel addresses), 1938 aerial not yet checked
Unconfirmed, one source for the spot
